description: Which EU countries have transposed the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 into national law? For one or all 27 member states: the national act that states it transposes the Directive, a draft only, nothing found, or a source that refused access, with links, publication dates, the act's own words on when it applies, and the date each source was opened. Not for: the content of national pay rules (get_job_ad_rules and the other tools).

member_state.description: Two-letter EU country code, e.g. DE (Germany), FR (France), ES (Spain), PL (Poland). Leave out for all 27 member states.

name: eu_transposition_status
title: EU transposition status
